input: matrix is a rectangular list of r rows, each containing c integers in [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991]. r and c are in [0, 4294967295], with r*c <= 4294967295; an empty outer list has c = 0. Rows may share identities because they are read only. Empty matrices and zero-width rows are accepted. String inputs, when present, are ordinary str values, not subclasses. Integer values are plain int, excluding bool; lists are ordinary lists, not subclasses. There is no concurrent mutation or monkey-patching of standard built-ins. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. Allocation and runtime resource limits still require qualification; this declared domain is not a capacity or completion guarantee.
return: A fresh flat list of all r*c matrix values in clockwise spiral order, starting at the top-left cell and moving right first. Each cell position contributes exactly once, even if values repeat or input rows alias. Empty or zero-width matrices return a fresh empty list.
mutation_aliasing: All inputs, their ordering and caller-owned containers remain unchanged. The Solution instance retains no state, and separate calls share no mutable result state. The result never aliases the outer input or any row. Values are immutable integers copied by value; modifying the result cannot affect input rows.
numeric: Values are never arithmetically transformed. Row/column endpoints, increments and decrements remain exact safe integers, including -1 boundary sentinels. The output length is at most 4294967295.
complexity: O(r*c + 1) time and O(1) auxiliary space excluding the O(r*c + 1) result container. The four shrinking boundaries visit each cell exactly once. Bottom and left passes are guarded to avoid repeating a lone row or column. No input copy, recursion or destructive traversal marker is used.
